short_bio: Film producer who co-founded Amblin Entertainment and became president of Lucasfilm in 2012.
biography:
Kathleen Kennedy was born in Berkeley, California, and studied at San Diego State University. She began in local television and then worked as an assistant to Steven Spielberg.

In 1981 she co-founded Amblin Entertainment with Spielberg and Frank Marshall and produced E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982). With Marshall she later formed the Kennedy/Marshall Company, whose credits include The Sixth Sense (1999) and The Curious Case of Benjamin Button (2008).

In 2012 George Lucas named her co-chair of Lucasfilm and then its president after he sold the company to Disney. She produced Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015).
